impact-interference.dxbc: the shipped Interference.UniFinal pixel shader
(ps_5_0, 7,872 bytes), extracted read-only from GRID 2's
shaderpack/dx11/postprocess.pssg (SHA-256
b14e2b958cce18dc67d8316312661abe54933839e343c8bf8b0e24293c4bd7af) at byte offset
120058. Its renderer fingerprint (FNV-1a 64 of the bytecode, as passed to
CreatePixelShader) is 2d81beb22b54d6cc. The same extraction reproduces all four
known motion-blur fingerprints from that file. The pass's vertex shader
(Interference.UniFinal.psh.vp_interference) is c28cc7496cb23aae.

The shader glitches a pixel only when the interference map alpha (t0) is below
cb0[78].w, the interferenceParams gate at byte 1260 of the 1296-byte
post-process constants (interferenceParams is cb0[76..79], offset 1216).
Otherwise it takes a pass-through branch (a YUV round trip of t1). The test
renders this exact shader on WARP and requires the patched constants to match
the gate-closed pass-through byte for byte.
